Achieved power for a given sample size

Source: R/power_by_trial_design.R
get_achieved_power.Rd

Inverts a one-argument required-sample-size function to find the power at which the required sample size equals a current sample size. Useful for reporting the power a fixed trial achieves.

Usage

get_achieved_power(n_required_fun, N_current, interval = c(0.001, 0.999))

Arguments

n_required_fun

A function of a single argument (power) returning the required sample size, e.g. n_required_by_design() with its other arguments held fixed.

N_current

The available (fixed) sample size.

interval

Search interval for the power root.

Value

The achieved power rounded to 3 digits, or the strings ">0.999" / "<0.001" when the power lies outside the search interval.
